{{Quote|Well, Meatlump Wine is made from...well...I need you to go around the hideout and squash all the rodents you can find. Collect their juices and return them to me.|Chef Schlump|<ref name="SWG:WO" />}}
'''Worrmps''' were small creatures known to inhabit the sewer systems of the [[Meatlump Hideout]] beneath the streets of the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Although they closely resembled [[Worrt/Legends|worrts]] in appearance, [[Chef/Legends|Chef]] [[Schlump]] referred to the worrmps as [[Rodent/Legends|rodents]]. The [[Meatlumps|Meatlump Gang]] was known to stomp on the worrmps and [[meetle]]s infesting their hideout, and use their juices to create [[Meatlump wine]], a preferred [[Wine/Legends|drink]] of the [[Meatlump King]].<ref name="SWG:WO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Worrmps first appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:WO" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Worrmps were added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Meatlumps Theme Park|Meatlumps Theme Park]]", introduced with "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 10|Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King]]," released on [[June 19]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67812&month=062008|text=Chapter 10: The Search for the Meatlump King}}</ref>
